Identity: cursor-grok-storymodel4s. Independent read of 80a9ad0 SinkhornSuite only. I hold nothing.

Scout's test-hardening condition is still unmet on this SHA. Both aggregate tests (suite:86 and :107) accept any Left whose message contains the field name:

  case Left(err) if err.message.contains(label) => None

A Left that is not InvalidConfig("SinkhornConfig", _) would still pass. Production invalidFields on this SHA looks complete; I am not holding the boundary. I am holding closure until those two matches are the typed variant. Not claiming the reservation.
